Beautiful Venom

Rina Kent

Discover the steamy new dark hockey romance from the bestselling author of the Legacy of Gods series

IN A DEN OF VIPERS, REVENGE IS THE DEADLIEST WEAPON.

After my sister was attacked and hospitalised, my world was shattered.

Now, all I have left is vengeance.

The problem? I have no idea who did this to her.

My only lead is The Vipers, an elite college hockey team that rules the ice―and the shadows beyond it.
To infiltrate their secret society, I set my sights on their weakest Kane Davenport, the Viper’s charismatic captain.

But too late, I realise I’ve enticed the most venomous snake.

Behind Kane’s perfect mask lies something far more dangerous than I ever imagined.

AND NOW I’M TRAPPED IN A LETHAL GAME WITH NO ESCAPE.

About the author

Rina Kent

65 books75.5k followers
Rina Kent is a New York Times, USA Today, and #1 bestselling author of all things dark romance.
Better known for writing unapologetic anti-heroes and villains, Rina weaves tales of characters you shouldn’t fall for but inevitably do. Her stories are laced with a touch of darkness, a splash of angst, and just the right amount of unhealthy intensity.
When she’s not busy plotting mayhem for her ever-expanding Rinaverse, she leads a private life in London, travels, and pampers her cats in true Cat Lady fashion.

Book: Beautiful Venom by Rina Kent
Rating: 2 stars (?? maybe? who knows anymore)
Format: Audiobook (aka torture device edition)
Narrated by: Corvin King & Michelle Sparks (who honestly deserved better than this script)

Okay so here's the deal...

If I could erase the initiation scene and every unnecessary, eyeball-melting "sex" scene (and yes, I use that word loosely), this might’ve actually been… dare I say it… decent? Like plot-wise? Maybe? But guess what? You can’t erase those scenes, they’re right there. Loud. Cringe. Unskippable. And since I was trapped in the audiobook dungeon... no, I couldn’t skim. I had to suffer through every groan, grunt, and braincell-slaughtering dialogue like a hostage.

If I could’ve hit “2x speed” on life itself, I would have.

Let’s talk about Kane "I Have a God Complex and a Degradation Kink" Davenport.

He started off strong. Like, actual butterflies. I was THERE. Kicking my feet, giggling like a fool. Hot hockey captain with green flags?? Girl, sign me up. And then... he opened his mouth.

"Your cunt will be my dick’s punching bag."

I’m sorry. WHAT??

I swear, every time Kane got horny, he also got possessed by the spirit of every red-flagged Wattpad villain from 2012. And no, not the hot kind. The “I need therapy and maybe jail time” kind.

I’m all for spice, but did we really need him to be an Olympic-level a-hole during every single scene? Like, there’s a difference between dark romance and unhinged human rights violation. Learn it.

And let’s not even get started on how he backhand slaps her and it’s brushed off like it’s part of foreplay. Like, no. That’s not it. That’s not it AT ALL. 😐

Also, the dirty talk? Look, I get degradation kink is a thing. Some people like it, cool. But why do all of Rina’s women start purring the second they get called a “cumhole”?? Like PLEASE. Have some dignity. Or at least a personality beyond horny masochist with no self-esteem.

Now... Dahlia “I’m out for revenge but mostly vibes” Thorne.

Where. Was. The. Bite.

Girl was hyped up as a vengeance queen, but all I saw was a confused, sad puppy who just happened to trip and fall into trauma sex with the guy she’s supposed to take down. Ten times in one chapter. 😭

And the worst part? I actually LIKED her. Under all the chaos, there was something there. Her protectiveness over Violet? Actual heartwarming stuff. But then Rina was like, “You know what would fix this character? Let’s make her get off to being insulted during non-consensual roleplay.” 🧍‍♀️

Her “revenge” was so unserious, it should’ve been a TikTok prank.

Plot? Barely.
Pacing? Whack.
Character development? Non-existent.
Sex scenes? Painful and weirdly violent.
Degradation kink? Overused to the point of becoming a parody.

The book had potential. Like, the bones of a dark college sports revenge romance? Count me in.
But then Rina said “You know what this story needs? Absolutely deranged initiation rituals and ten pages of violent moaning.”

So yeah. I'm conflicted. The narration was okay. Some lines even slapped. But most of the time, I was stuck between clutching my ears and rolling my eyes so hard I saw my past lives.

FINAL VERDICT:
If you enjoy reading about women being humiliated under the excuse of “kink” while plot peeks through in tiny gasps of air, this book is for you.

But if you're like me, and your “dark romance” phase is hanging on by its last frayed thread, maybe skip this one before it cuts the rope completely.

Rina, please write ONE book without using r@pe and calling it character development. Just one. I beg.

⌞THE RELATIONSHIP ⌝

"Kane asks what I’m thinking. Seriously, maybe that guy is only in Vencor because he was born into a founding family. He obviously doesn’t belong there."

“Is your tantrum over?"
"I wasn’t throwing a tantrum, but if you want one, I’ll gladly deliver.”

“I slap his hand away. 'Don’t touch me unless you’re ready to fully commit. And this is not a ‘don’t touch me that means you can use me.’ This is a ‘red,’ Kane.”

Dahlia roasting him, showing him attitude, then demanding the better parts of him, ghosting him, all while making him jealous by parading with her ex. yes, yes, i fuck with that. 🫢

“Call her a bitch again and I’ll cut out your tongue.”

Kane was veryyy smitten by her. he defended her a lot, cared for her a lot, and legit threatened his friends and everyone who dared to touch Dahlia. his protectiveness was top-notch. i was wary of him in the start, but damn, he's possessive! 😌

“I don’t know what love is and whether or not it’s real, but if it exists, you’re its definition for me.”

IT ALSO HAS GROVELING ‼️‼️ and Kane Davenport is not shy about saying 'sorry'.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️¼ — 4,25/5 🌺✨🖤

“You’ve conquered me, heart and soul, Dahlia. I don’t know what love is and whether or not it’s real, but if it exists, you’re its definition for me.”

I went in expecting a controlled but tense reading experience 😮‍💨, and I ended up finishing it in one sitting. The pacing makes it easy to stay immersed from start to finish, with a steady pull that never breaks. Everything is shaped by restraint, where what’s left unsaid carries more weight than what is actually shown. The connection builds quietly through subtle interaction and distance, keeping the focus on what exists between them rather than what is openly expressed.

Dahlia Thorne is observant and careful in her responses. She evaluates situations before reacting, maintaining awareness of what is happening around her. Her strength is expressed through control and composure 😌, especially in moments where emotional pressure is present. She remains steady, relying on reflection and measured judgment rather than impulsive decisions.

Kane Davenport is reserved, composed, and intentionally guarded 🫣. He maintains control over his reactions and presents himself with a quiet intensity that shapes every interaction. Subtle changes appear in his composure during his exchanges with Dahlia ❤️‍🩹, adding depth without disrupting his overall controlled presence.

Overall, it’s a story built on restraint, emotional control, and a consistently charged atmosphere 🫠. Nothing feels exaggerated or overexplained; instead, everything unfolds through subtle tension and unspoken shifts in energy. It’s the kind of reading experience that stays steady from beginning to end, leaving an impression rooted more in feeling than in specific events.

My rating of The Vipers Series:

1. Beautiful Venom — 4.25 ⭐️
2. Sweet Venom — 4 ⭐️
3. Tempting Venom — TBR

2.35 stars 😃 (Yes, I’m being very generous, trust me 🙂‍↕️)

Keeping this review short—not because I don’t have a lot to say, but because if I really go off… it might turn into something not so appropriate 🙂‍↕️

⚠️ DISCLAIMER ⚠️
‼️ If you loved, liked, or even tolerated Beautiful Venom, you might wanna skip this ‼️

Alright folks, here we go.

👀So why the random 0.35 stars if I clearly didn’t enjoy it? That’s for Preston & Marcus, Preston forgetting Dahlia’s name, Vi and her backstory, and a few moments of solid banter. That’s it. That’s the tweet. 🙂‍↕️

Now let’s talk about that “FMC who bites back” promise that was made… because I’m still out here looking for her 😃 The FMC in this book? Girl barely barked, let alone bit. She “accidentally” kneed the MMC—and then apologized 😃😃 Like ma’am… that man is literally abusing you… and you’re apologizing? Okay 😔💀

Small W for the characters: non-virgin FMC and non-manwhore MMC. We love to see it 🥰 That was the one bright spot in this otherwise very dim reading experience.

Y’all. It got so bad I actually CLOSED the book and went outside… like actually TOUCHED GRASS 😃 Me. A person who rarely steps out by choice. This book had me unlocking new life achievements 😌

Did I want to DNF? 1000%. Did I? Nope. Because I made a silent vow not to DNF Rina’s books. Once upon a time, I really loved her writing. (Still do—as long as it’s not these books.)

I finished it. I don’t know how, but I did. Promise: fulfilled. 🫡

That’s all. Byeeee.
🎀 To those who enjoyed it—I’m genuinely happy for you. But this one? Definitely not for me. 🎀

Plot Summary
After a brutal attack leaves her sister clinging to life, Dahlia Thorne is consumed by a need to uncover the truth and make those responsible pay. With no clear suspects, her only lead points to the Vipers—a powerful and mysterious college hockey team known for more than just their skills on the ice. To break into their world, she sets her sights on Kane Davenport, the team’s magnetic captain and seemingly the least dangerous of the group. But the deeper she goes, the more she realises Kane isn’t the safe bet she thought. Beneath his charm lies something far darker, and soon Dahlia finds herself caught in a twisted game of lies, obsession, and power—where her plan for revenge might cost her everything.

Tropes
▪︎ Dark hockey romance
▪︎ Secret society
▪︎ Enemies to lovers
▪︎ FMC out for revenge

Basically, I just got annoyed too many times, so I lowered my rating. That’s what happened.

Rating: 2 stars.
“I’m your winter, Dahlia. No flower can survive winter. Not even wildflowers.”
Yeah, as you can tell… that easy 4 stars quickly dropped to a 2 the moment I actually sat and thought about it. Funny how a little reflection can completely change how you feel about a book.

Another day, another enemies-to-lusters from Rina. She dropped the ball again, and yet here I am, showing up for it like I always do. At this point, I can’t even blame Rina anymore. The problem is clearly me. I’m too far gone, too deep in this universe to stop now. I’ve read every book, main characters, side characters, background cameos, you name it. And no matter how messy it gets, I know I’ll keep coming back. Some of my friends have already quit her books, and maybe one day I’ll be that strong… but today is not that day.

➺ Dahlia:
oh, Dahlia. She’s bold and dramatic, sure, but her actions often cross the line from passionate to straight-up cringy and annoying. Her desperate attempts to get Kane’s attention, especially the manipulative ones, made it hard to root for her. I wanted to empathize with her pain and vulnerability, but so many of her choices just left me sighing in disbelief.

➺ Kane:
Kane Davenport is your classic cold, emotionally detached MMC who’s supposed to fall hard for the “sweet but strong” heroine. But instead of slow burn chemistry, we get an emotional sense of war that felt toxic more than romantic. I really wanted to throw up every time this man open his mouth.
Ohhh and when he told her that your tears made me a monster, I was like "bruh, are you for real? you are already one!"


Their relationship lacked emotional depth and genuine connection. Instead of a powerful enemies to lovers transformation, it felt like two broken people constantly pushing each other’s buttons without ever truly healing or growing. I can’t lie, I was giggling sometimes but other than than it was just disgust and a lot of wth.

PLEASE, I’m on my knees begging, Rina, don’t mess this one up. I am such a sucker for the grumpy/sunshine dynamic, and Jude and Violet are serving it perfectly. Give me all the tension, the banter, the emotional whiplash, I want it all. I don’t care how cliché it is, I want this trope injected straight into my veins.


_____

"In a den of vipers, revenge is the deadliest venom."
I was reading The Fake Mate and honestly couldn’t handle the cringe anymore! 😭 so my brain immediately went, “You know what I actually miss? Rina’s books.” Her writing just hits different. I’m so ready to dive into this one and binge it in one sitting, though I’ll admit, I’m a little nervous since the reviews seem pretty mixed. Still, I’m going in with an open heart and high hopes because if anyone can pull me out of this feeling, it’s Rina. Let’s see where this ride takes me!

SO DARK SPORTS ROMANCE WITH ENEMIES TO LOVERS …yeah, don’t tell me again; I am already SAT. 🪑
